name: cja_sdr_config
description: Configuration preflight and status checks for cja_auto_sdr. Use 'validate_config' to verify credentials and connectivity before running generation or governance commands. Use 'config_status' to inspect current effective configuration. Use 'show_config' to see every credential source, the path of each file, and any notices, without an API call. These are lightweight, read-only operations suitable for agent preflight checks.

command.description: Config command to run. 'validate_config' tests credential resolution and API connectivity. 'config_status' displays the effective configuration for the selected profile. 'show_config' (--show-config) reports every credential source that holds a value, with file paths, problems and notices, and makes no API call.

config_json.description: When true, emit JSON. With config_status it is the --config-json output. With show_config it is the adobe-credentials/v1/config-check shape (the same as --show-config --format json). It does not apply to validate_config.

config_file.description: Path to a custom config file (--config-file, or its second name --config). Overrides the default config.json in the working directory.

profile.description: Named credential profile to validate or inspect. Defaults to the default profile.
